reasons.description: The input as a whole is not a single complete encoding.
The input contains no octets.
The input ends before the encoding is complete.
Octets remain after one complete encoding.
The identifier octets are invalid.
The high-tag-number form encodes a tag number below 31 (X.690 8.1.2.3).
The first subsequent identifier octet has bits 7 to 1 all zero (X.690 8.1.2.4.2 c).
The length octets are invalid.
The initial length octet is the reserved value FF (X.690 8.1.3.5 c).
A primitive encoding uses the indefinite length form (X.690 8.1.3.2 a).
The length form is not the one the encoding rules require, such as indefinite in DER or definite for a constructed CER encoding (X.690 9.1, 10.1).
A definite length is not encoded in the minimum number of octets (X.690 9.1, 10.1).
A nested encoding extends beyond the contents of the enclosing constructed encoding.
The end-of-contents octets are missing, misplaced or malformed.
An indefinite-length encoding has no end-of-contents octets (X.690 8.1.3.6).
End-of-contents octets appear outside an indefinite-length encoding.
End-of-contents octets are not exactly two zero octets (X.690 8.1.5).
The primitive or constructed form is not permitted.
A constructed encoding is used where the rules require the primitive form.
A primitive encoding is used where the rules require the constructed form.
The contents octets are invalid for the type or the encoding rules.
The number of contents octets is not permitted for the type, such as a BOOLEAN that is not one octet (X.690 8.2.1).
An INTEGER or ENUMERATED value is not encoded in the minimum number of octets (X.690 8.3.2).
The contents are valid BER but not the canonical CER or DER form, such as a BOOLEAN TRUE other than FF (X.690 11.1).
Components are not in the canonical order the encoding rules require.
SET OF components are not in the canonical order (X.690 11.6).
The encoding does not match the expected type.
An identifier does not match the tag the type requires.
A mandatory component of a SEQUENCE or SET is absent.

capabilities.description: Typed INTEGER and ENUMERATED values outside the signed 64-bit range.
Typed OBJECT IDENTIFIER arcs greater than 2^64 - 1.
